summary: Iteration 2 focused test: Google/Telegram integrations, Voice STT, task 404 responses, and Settings UI. Backend 9/9 pytest cases passed. Frontend Settings page renders both integration cards with correct states, Telegram code generation + deep link work, mic button present on Chat page, Impostazioni tab visible in dashboard nav. Telegram bot long-polling confirmed running in backend logs ('Telegram bot polling started').
critical_code_review_comments: google_callback swallows exchange_code exceptions and returns RedirectResponse but the unused variable 'e' triggers lint noise; also user_id from state is unused after auto-folder branch on error path.
server.py is 750 lines and mixes auth, chat, tasks, todos, integrations, and voice - consider splitting into routers modules (auth.py, tasks.py, integrations.py, voice.py) for maintainability.
PATCH /api/tasks/{id} accepts arbitrary dict payload without Pydantic validation - any unknown field will be persisted directly. Consider a TaskPatch model.

voice_transcribe: temp file suffix logic accepts only whitelisted ext, but uploads with no filename default to 'webm' which is fine; however if OpenAI whisper library needs bytes API changes in future the current file-open pattern is correct.
Google OAuth: exchange failure returns RedirectResponse even on invalid state cases - acceptable, but consider logging the state to trace fraud.
test_credentials: session_token='test_session_demo_12345' for user 'test-user-demo' (Marco Rossi). Sent as Bearer token in backend tests and as cookie in Playwright.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 fully green. Backend: /api/integrations/status returns google.configured=false & telegram.configured=true with bot_username='mAIPAL_bot'. /api/integrations/google/authorize returns 400 as expected while GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET empty. /api/integrations/telegram/link-code creates codes and invalidates previous ones. /api/integrations/telegram/disconnect returns {ok:true}. /api/voice/transcribe accepts a 1s 440Hz WAV and returns {text} (Whisper via emergentintegrations, italian). PATCH+DELETE /api/tasks/{missing_id} correctly return 404. PATCH calendar_synced=true without Google connection returns 400 with italian error message. Frontend Settings page has google-card, telegram-card, tg-gen-code -> tg-code + deep link https://t.me/mAIPAL_bot?start=<code>, google-connect button correctly disabled when not configured. Impostazioni tab present in dashboard nav. Chat page mic-btn renders and click does not throw. Real audio recording not tested (requires --use-fake-ui-for-media-stream Chromium flag).
rca of the issue: N/A - no failures observed in this iteration.
